newsitem.title: USA: True North completes Modem Media deal.
newsitem.headline: True North completes Modem Media deal.

text.p: True North Communications Inc on Friday said it completed a transaction that combined its TN Technologies unit with Modem Media Advertising LP, a digital communications company based in Westport, Conn.
Under the terms of the deal, announced in October, Modem Media became part of TN Technologies, True North's digital marketing communications unit.

Modem Media was to have received $25 million of True North common stock in the transaction, plus an additional $4 million of True North common stock upon an initial public offering of TN Technologies shares. The IPO is pending.

TN Technologies' products and services include customized product positioning; creation and maintenance of sites on the Internet's World Wide Web sites, and analysis of customer responses, requests and purchases, among others.
True North is the parent of Foote, Cone & Belding, an advertising company.
